title: Problem Set 1 - Descriptive Statistics
description: Five problems on summary statistics histograms and boxplots using the NHANES sample dataset.

title: Problem Set 2 - Probability and Distributions
description: Problems on normal binomial and Poisson distributions with applied public health scenarios.

title: Problem Set 3 - Confidence Intervals and t-tests
description: Hand calculations of CIs and two-sample t-tests with paired and unpaired data.

title: Midterm Exam
description: In-class midterm covering Units 1-2. Closed book one page of notes allowed.

title: Problem Set 4 - Linear Regression
description: Fit interpret and diagnose linear regression models in R using the framingham subset.

title: Problem Set 5 - Logistic Regression
description: Fit and interpret logistic models with categorical predictors and report odds ratios with CIs.

title: Problem Set 6 - Survival Analysis
description: Construct KM curves by hand and in R. Identify the censoring assumption in each scenario.

title: Final Exam
description: Cumulative final covering all units. Two hours in class.

title: KM Estimator Practice Quiz
description: Five-minute warm-up quiz at start of Lecture 11. Censoring assumption short answer.
